data.question_intent: Mechanics of hedging instant access in anticipation of rate cuts
data.question_quote: I just have one question left that hasn't been answered and it relates to the mechanics of the hedge in terms of thinking about rate cuts going forward.
data.answer_quote: Fixed rate products we will hedge to the fixed term, but we will take into account, the date of maturity across the portfolio view. On products where we determine the margin, so a managed rate book or managed rate savings product, we will take a view on what we think the pass through is likely to be given the experience that we've had, given our perspective on the market and we'll hedge to that as a sort of proportion of the book. And then instant access, or NIBCA products we will generally view as a fixed rate product as zero.
